== Japanese printed face ==
Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. The Japanese explicitly explains that the extra destiny is separate from ordinary battle destiny and does not add to attrition. It does not explicitly say “both sides,” as the English printing does. The Japanese title means “Dusk.” Publication ID 1301_56o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim. Source preservation remains pending.
